At the Smooth Company, we like things to run smoothly (pun intended!) What don’t we like? Things that ruin your day… like a bad hair day. Let's face it, we’ve all been there! That’s why we create innovative, premium beauty products designed not just to smooth your hair, but to help your day run more smoothly.

The Smooth Company began with one woman, one wand and a very stubborn baby hair. CEO Áine sought to create a hair hero that could tame flyaways and baby hairs without crunch, grease or stickiness and would still leave hair feeling like hair. Nearly two years (and a lot of testing) later, the award winning Smooth Stick™ was born; enriched with Biotin, Vitamin E and Aloe Vera to keep hair healthy while holding it in place all day. Since then we have expanded the core product range to 10 viral hair smoothing products and tools.

Áine launched the Smooth Company in her attic in 2022, with her Grandad Billy helping to pack orders. They shared the start up journey on social media - both wins and wobbles. This sparked a wave of support, generating over 150 million view on TikTok. Today, the Smooth Company has grown into a global beauty brand loved in 90+ countries around the world, landing in some of the top retailers globally. We have featured in Vogue, and attracted fans such as Molly Mae, Maya Jama and top celebrity hair stylists. We’ve also picked up a few awards along the way, including Best Hair Brand 2024 at the Image PWC Beauty of Business Awards.

Despite our global success, it's so important to us to stay true to our roots. We are committed to sustainability, and our products are cruelty-free and packed with ingredients your hair will love. Our Community is at the heart of everything we do and our customers have been with us from day one, shaping the products we create and the future we’re building. That's why we launched our Smooth Social Club as a way to connect with our community and thank our customers for their support. Smoothness isn’t just beauty, it’s a movement. Together, we are not just making hair smoother, we are creating a legacy beauty brand for the next generation.

While we know there is more to life than hair, we think it’s a pretty good place to start! We would love you to join our story and be part of yours.

Ready, Set, Smooth!
settings.pf_fb417986_value:
Founder, Director and Owner
Áine Kennedy, a young entrepreneur from Dublin.
She has a degree in Entrepreneurship from Maynooth University and over 6 years of experience in Brand Management and Marketing in the beauty industry. Her career began at age 16, working in Boots, then Benefit Cosmetics. Most recently she competed in the presitgious EY Entrepreneur of the Year Programme and was awarded the title of EY Emerging Entrepreneur of the Year. 
The Smooth Company is dedicated to her Nana Carmel, who always had a hair tip or trick up her sleeve. Family is important to Aine with her Grandad Billy featuring in many TikTok videos, and her sister Eimear helping to run the company. Together, they bring a personal and family-driven touch to The Smooth Company, connecting with it's growing community.
